summary: README.md and module-context.yaml confirmed fully updated by prior documentation agent (WP-004 documentation pipeline). Two-tier caching pattern documented, strategy ID constants documented, APICacheException documented, all three new files included in module-context.yaml.

Fixed by either quoting affected entries or rewriting them to avoid the problematic colon patterns. All 23 keyword entries now parse as strings.

summary: WP-005 reviewed. All acceptance criteria are met. README.md fully and accurately documents the two-tier caching pattern, both interface/trait pairs, strategy ID constants, cache key generation, error handling, and APICacheException error codes — cross-validated against the implementation source files. The module-context.yaml wildcard (*.php at ./) correctly captures all three new files (APICacheException.php, UserScopedCacheInterface.php, UserScopedCacheTrait.php), confirmed by the generated architecture-core.md (596 lines). composer dump-autoload and composer build both pass. One non-blocking observation recorded regarding the stale source description field in module-context.yaml.

comments.note: The `description` field in the architecture-core source definition in module-context.yaml (line: 'APICacheException, APICacheStrategyInterface, APICacheManager, CacheableAPIMethodInterface, CacheableAPIMethodTrait, APIResponseCacheLocation') is stale — it does not list UserScopedCacheInterface or UserScopedCacheTrait. Because CTX Generator uses this value as the generated document's title/header, the .context/modules/api-cache/architecture-core.md heading omits the new classes. The actual file content is complete (the *.php glob picks them up). Recommend updating the description to include 'UserScopedCacheInterface, UserScopedCacheTrait' so the document header accurately reflects its contents — this is the primary way agents learn what a CTX document contains without reading it in full.

Minor README omission: the quick-reference Classes table lists all classes except APICacheException (which is covered separately under the APICacheException and Error Handling sections). The omission is not harmful — the class has comprehensive dedicated coverage — but adding it to the Classes table would make the quick-reference guide complete. Non-blocking.

No blocking issues found. Security review: path-traversal guard in APICacheManager::getMethodCacheFolder() is correct (empty, '/', '..', DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR checks). Empty-identifier hard failure in UserScopedCacheTrait prevents cache scope collapse. Cache key generation (ksort + json_encode JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR + md5) is deterministic and injection-safe. Array union operator semantics in UserScopedCacheTrait correctly enforce _userScope precedence. The @phpstan-require-implements annotations on both traits are solid static-analysis enforcement.
